table.retrieve:
select  
	Type = 'Sales',
	username=(select username from users where users.usercode=SL.salesmancode),
	saleinvcode=SL.saleinvcode,
	date=max(SL.date),
	itemalias=Max(I.customicode),
	itemname=I.name,
	itempacking=(select name from itempacking where itempacking.packcode=Max(I.packcode)),
	saleprice=SD.saleprice, 
	looseqty=sum(SD.looseqty),
	total=Round(sum(SD.looseqty * SD.saleprice),2),
	itemdiscval=Round(sum(SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice*0.01*SD.discperc) + (SD.looseqty*SD.itemflatdisc)),2),
	AfterItemdisctotal=Round(sum(SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.saleprice*0.01*SD.discperc) - (SD.looseqty*SD.itemflatdisc)),2),
	commissionperunit=Round(sum(SD.commissionperunit*SD.looseqty),2),
	commissionperc=Round(sum((Round((SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)*(1 - 0.01*SD.discperc),2)*0.01*SD.commissionperc)*SD.looseqty),2),
	totalcommission=Round(sum(SD.commissionperunit*SD.looseqty),2)  +  Round(sum((Round((SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)*(1 - 0.01*SD.discperc),2)*0.01*SD.commissionperc)*SD.looseqty),2),
	invtotal=Max(SL.invtotal),
	saletype=(CASE max(SL.salecatcode) when 3 THEN 'Cash' ELSE 'Credit' END),
	posted=max(SL.posted)
from saleledger SL,
	saledetail SD,
	item I
where SL.date>=:ar_startdate   and
	SL.date<=:ar_enddate and
	SL.salesmancode IN (:ar_usercode) and
	SL.salecatcode IN (:aa_saletype) and
	SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode and
	SD.icode=I.icode
group by SL.salesmancode,
	 SL.saleinvcode,
	 I.icode,
	 I.name,
	 SD.saleprice,
	 SD.discperc,
	 SD.commissionperunit,
	 SD.commissionperc,
	 SD.discperc,
	 SD.itemflatdisc,
	 SD.gstperc,
	 SD.unitsalestax
UNION ALL
select  
	Type = 'Sales Return',
	username=(select username from users where users.usercode=SL.salesmancode),
	saleinvcode=SL.srinvcode,
	date=max(SL.date),
	itemalias=Max(I.customicode),
	itemname=I.name,
	itempacking=(select name from itempacking where itempacking.packcode=Max(I.packcode)),
	saleprice=SD.srprice, 
	looseqty=sum(SD.looseqty),
	total=Round(sum(SD.looseqty * SD.srprice),2),
	itemdiscval=Round(sum((SD.looseqty*SD.srprice*0.01*SD.discperc)),2),
	AfterItemdisctotal=Round(sum(SD.looseqty*(SD.srprice - SD.srprice*0.01*SD.discperc)),2),
	commissionperunit=Round(sum(SD.commissionperunit*SD.looseqty),2),
	commissionperc=Round(sum((Round(SD.srprice*(1 - 0.01*SD.discperc),2)*0.01*SD.commissionperc)*SD.looseqty),2),
	totalcommission=Round(sum(SD.commissionperunit*SD.looseqty),2)  +  Round(sum((Round(SD.srprice * (1 - 0.01*SD.discperc),2)*0.01*SD.commissionperc)*SD.looseqty),2),
	invtotal=Max(SL.invtotal),
	saletype=(CASE max(SL.srcatcode) when 8 THEN 'Cash' ELSE 'Credit' END),
	posted=max(SL.posted)
from srledger SL,
	srdetail SD,
	item I
where SL.date>=:ar_startdate   and
	SL.date<=:ar_enddate and
	SL.salesmancode IN (:ar_usercode) and
	SL.srinvcode=SD.srinvcode and
	SD.icode=I.icode
group by SL.salesmancode,
	 SL.srinvcode,
	 I.icode,
	 I.name,
	 SD.srprice,
	 SD.discperc,
	 SD.commissionperunit,
	 SD.commissionperc,
	 SD.discperc,
	 SD.gstperc,
	 SD.unitsalestax
order by 
	username,
	type,
	saleinvcode,
	itemname
table.sort: username A, type A, saleinvcode A, itemname A
